description: This Java class 'ThingDefinitionCreatedStrategy' handles 'ThingDefinitionCreated' events within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically implementing an immutable strategy that applies the event to modify a 'ThingBuilder' object by setting its definition.

classes.name: ThingDefinitionCreatedStrategy
classes.description: An immutable final class that extends AbstractThingEventStrategy to handle 'ThingDefinitionCreated' events by applying them to a 'ThingBuilder'.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply the 'ThingDefinitionCreated' event by setting the definition on the 'ThingBuilder'.
